newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican o/n Cetes rate ends down on auction hopes.
newsitem.headline: Mexican o/n Cetes rate ends down on auction hopes.

text.p: Mexico's overnight Cetes rate moderated early gains to close down 30 basis points at 21.90 percent on Monday on expectations that primary rates would again fall across the board at this week's central bank auction, traders said.
"You could tell foreigners stepped in to try to square positions before auction rates fall tomorrow," a trader said.
Money market analysts and traders agreed Cetes rates could fall on all issues at Banco de Mexico's auction on Tuesday.
But they did warn that rates could rise again in future auctions as real returns fell considerably in recent weeks.
Traders added that, although rates did seesaw during the day, the overall trend was downward.
Overnight rates on bank paper, meanwhile, closed up 15 basis points at 23.85 percent.

Banco de Mexico injected 3.001 billion pesos in liquidity by auctioning two credits. The minimum assigned rate for Monday was below Friday's minimum. Total credit maturities for Tuesday were estimated at 5.728 billion pesos.
